{#- PRINT FORMAT: Vendor Work Orders DocType: Vendors Reference copy of the Desk record "Vendor Work Orders" -- the DB record is the runtime source; keep this file equal to it. Rows come from the SAME endpoint, filters, search and sort as the Vendor page's Work Orders tab (nirmaan_stack.api.data-table.get_list_with_count_enhanced, like its "Export all"), so the PDF lists exactly what the table shows. Query-string params (absent = all of the vendor's listed WOs, last modified first): wo_view "all" | "approved" | "finalized" -- the tab's sub-tab (default "all") wo_filters JSON array of the table's column filters (Frappe filter list) order_by e.g. "creation desc" search_term the table's search box search_field the field the search box searches item_search "1" when that field is the item-name (child table) search The vendor + the view's status filters are always added here (the same staticFilters as all-sr-list / approved-sr-list / finalized-sr-list), so a request can only narrow the list to this vendor's work orders. -#} {%- set wo_view = frappe.form_dict.wo_view if frappe.form_dict.wo_view in ["all", "approved", "finalized"] else "all" -%} {%- if wo_view == "approved" -%} {%- set view_filters = [["status", "=", "Approved"], ["is_finalized", "=", 0]] -%} {%- elif wo_view == "finalized" -%} {%- set view_filters = [["status", "=", "Approved"], ["is_finalized", "=", 1]] -%} {%- else -%} {#- LISTED_WORK_ORDER_STATUSES: a Work Order under amendment stays listed. -#} {%- set view_filters = [["status", "in", ["Approved", "Amendment"]]] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set extra_filters = json.loads(frappe.form_dict.wo_filters) if frappe.form_dict.wo_filters else [] -%} {%- set search_term = frappe.form_dict.search_term or None -%} {%- set search_field = frappe.form_dict.search_field or None -%} {%- set res = frappe.call( "nirmaan_stack.api.data-table.get_list_with_count_enhanced", doctype="Service Requests", fields=["name", "creation", "modified", "project", "vendor", "status", "is_finalized", "gst", "total_amount", "amount_paid", "amount_due", "amount_invoiced"], filters=[["vendor", "=", doc.name]] + view_filters + extra_filters, order_by=frappe.form_dict.order_by or "modified desc", limit_start=0, limit_page_length=0, search_term=search_term, current_search_fields=json.dumps([search_field]) if (search_term and search_field) else None, is_item_search=bool(search_term and frappe.form_dict.item_search == "1"), require_pending_items=False, to_cache=False, for_export=True, doc=None ) -%} {#- doc=None is required: frappe.call hands the endpoint the whole request form_dict, and in a real download_pdf that includes `doc` (the Vendors document object). The endpoint keeps unknown args in **kwargs and json.dumps them, which fails on a document ("not JSON serializable"). -#} {%- set wos = res["data"] if res else [] -%} {#- Service Requests stores only the project link: resolve the names in one query. -#} {%- set project_ids = wos | map(attribute="project") | select | unique | list -%} {%- set project_names = {} -%} {%- if project_ids -%} {%- for p in frappe.get_all("Projects", filters={"name": ["in", project_ids]}, fields=["name", "project_name"]) -%} {%- set _ = project_names.update({p.name: p.project_name}) -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- endif -%} {%- macro money(v) -%}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(v or 0, 2, None, "#,##,###.##") }}{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro day(d) -%}{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(d, "dd-MMM-yyyy") if d else "" }}{%- endmacro -%} {#- Pending Invoices = Amt. Paid less Total Invoiced, floored at 0 (utils/workOrderPendingInvoice.ts); the same expression is used per row below. -#} {%- set tot = namespace(total_amount=0, amount_paid=0, amount_due=0, amount_invoiced=0, pending=0) -%} {%- for wo in wos -%} {%- set tot.total_amount = tot.total_amount + (wo.total_amount or 0) -%} {%- set tot.amount_paid = tot.amount_paid + (wo.amount_paid or 0) -%} {%- set tot.amount_due = tot.amount_due + (wo.amount_due or 0) -%} {%- set tot.amount_invoiced = tot.amount_invoiced + (wo.amount_invoiced or 0) -%} {%- set tot.pending = tot.pending + ([0, (wo.amount_paid or 0) - (wo.amount_invoiced or 0)] | max) -%} {%- endfor -%} {#- Company header: the default GSTIN's billing address (a vendor spans projects). -#} {%- set default_gstin = "29ABFCS9095N1Z9" -%} {%- set company_name = "Nirmaan (Stratos Infra Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)" -%} {%- set logo_url = "https://stack.nirmaan.app/assets/nirmaan_stack/frontend/assets/logo-svg-BptBZTzQ.svg" -%} {%- set company_addr = "Billing address not configured (Check Project GST DocType)" -%} {%- set gst_name = frappe.db.get_value("Project GST", {"gstin": default_gstin}, "name") -%} {%- if gst_name -%} {%- set g = frappe.db.get_value("Project GST", gst_name, ["address", "city", "pincode", "state"], as_dict=True) -%} {%- set company_addr = [g.address, [g.city, g.pincode] | select | join("-"), g.state] | select | join(", ") -%} {%- endif -%} {#- Repeats on every page (wkhtmltopdf header). -#}
